V2_JobLineServiceRequestModel.description: The Service section of a service/remake/alteration job line: which original job/line the work relates to, the fault reason and who was responsible. All fields are null when not recorded.

amount.description: Portion of the payment's value allocated to the job.

jobID.description: Key of the job the payment portion is allocated to.

paymentID.description: Key of the customer payment being allocated.

V2_JobPaymentAllocationRequestModel.description: Allocates a portion of a customer payment against a specific job.

quoteExpiryDate.description: Date the quote lapses if the customer has not yet accepted it.

handoverDate.description: Date the completed job was handed over to the customer.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the job: open, closed or cancelled.

supplyNotes.description: Notes for suppliers/production about sourcing or making the goods on this job.

reference.description: System-generated job number users quote to identify the job.

projectCustomerPO.description: Customer's project name or purchase order reference for this job.

jobDate.description: Date the job (initially a quote) was raised.

etaDate.description: Expected date the ordered goods will arrive from suppliers.

coolingOffDate.description: Date after which the customer can no longer cancel under the cooling-off period.

extendedCoolingOffDaysID.description: Key of the cooling-off extension applied to this job.

estimatedDeliveryDate.description: Estimated date on which the completed order will be delivered to the customer.

stage.description: Sales pipeline stage of the job: quote, order (confirmed sale) or lost.

jobType.description: Whether this is a sales job or a service (repair/maintenance) job.

showroomQuote.description: True when the quote was created in the showroom rather than at the customer's site.

shipDirectToCustomer.description: True when goods for this job are shipped directly to the customer.

installNotes.description: Notes for the installer about carrying out the installation.

internalNotes.description: Internal staff-only notes; not shown to the customer.

customerNotes.description: Notes intended for the customer, e.g. shown on quote/order documents.

isSigned.description: True when the customer has signed (accepted) the quote.

wasSentToCSS.description: True when the job/quote has been sent to the customer via the Customer Self Service portal.

orderDate.description: Date the quote was converted to an order (confirmed). Null while still a quote. Pair with JobLineHistory to measure order-to-confirmed / check-measure durations.

lineCount.description: Number of active (non-cancelled, non-supplementary) lines on the job.

onHoldLineCount.description: Number of active lines currently on hold.

isConfirmed.description: True once the job is an order (all lines confirmed) rather than a quote.

salesRepID.description: Key of the salesperson responsible for this sale.

plannedInstallerID.description: Key of the user planned to carry out the installation.

addressID.description: Key of the installation site address.

deliveryAddressID.description: Key of the goods delivery address.

contactID.description: Key of the customer this job belongs to.

siteContactID.description: Key of the on-site contact at the installation site.

companyID.description: Key of the company the job is for.

customStatusID.description: Key of the user-defined custom status applied to the job.

commitmentReasonID.description: Key of the reason the customer committed to the order.

estimatedDeliveryDateTypeID.description: Key of the estimated delivery date type.

businessUnitID.description: Key of the business unit that owns this job.

opportunityID.description: Key of the sales opportunity this job originated from.

jobLines.description: Line items on the job: the individual products (blinds, curtains etc.) being sold.

paymentAllocations.description: Portions of customer payments allocated against this job.

activities.description: Activities (appointments, tasks) linked to this job.

jobLineHistories.description:
Status, Stage and DispatchStage transitions recorded across all lines on this job, e.g. to measure the time
from OrderDate until every line reached stage_job_line_confirmed.

V2_JobRequestModel.description: A customer sale that progresses from quote to confirmed order to installed; belongs to a Contact (the customer).

gclid.description: Optional Google Click ID captured for ad attribution.

fbclid.description: Optional Facebook Click ID captured for ad attribution.

clickTimestamp.description: Optional click timestamp captured for ad attribution.

appointmentMinutes.description: Represents the duration of the appointment to be booked in

filterByRoster.description: When set to true only rostered times for each sale rep will be checked for availability, when set to false 9am to 5pm is assumed.

filterBySkills.description: When set to true only reps with the required skills for the products of interest will be considered

productsOfInterests.description: Array of products of interest ids to be used when FilterBySkills is set to true

qty.description: Approximate number of units of this product type the prospect is interested in.

productName.description: Display name of the product type of interest

description.description: Short free-text description/title of the sales lead, e.g. what the prospect wants.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the lead: Open, Won, Lost or Abandoned.

pipelineStage.description: Sales pipeline stage the lead has reached: Lead, Negotiation, Quotation or Contract.

contactID.description: ID of the primary customer contact this lead is for.

siteContactID.description: ID of the contact at the installation/measure site, when different from the primary contact.

companyID.description: ID of the company/organisation the lead is associated with, for commercial prospects.

representativeID.description: ID of the sales representative (user) assigned to work this lead.

leadGeneratorID.description: ID of the user credited with generating this lead.

referedByID.description: ID of the existing contact who referred this prospect to the business.

forecast.description: Whether this lead is included in sales revenue forecasting.

visitedShowroom.description: Whether the prospect has visited the showroom.

expectedRevenue.description: Estimated sale value of the lead if it is won.

outcomeReasonID.description: Picklist ID of the reason explaining the quote outcome (why the lead was won or lost).

outcomeNotes.description: Free-text notes elaborating on the quote outcome (why the lead was won or lost).

closeDate.description: Date the lead was closed out (won, lost or abandoned).

notes.description: General free-text notes about the lead.

gclid.description: Google Ads click identifier (GCLID) used to attribute this lead to a Google ad click.

externalLeadID.description: ID of the external lead this opportunity was converted from.

leadSourceID.description: Picklist ID of the lead source describing how the prospect heard of the business.

confidenceLevelID.description: Picklist ID of the confidence level rating how likely the lead is to be won.

businessUnitID.description: ID of the business unit (branch/division) that owns this lead.

createdByID.description: ID of the user who created this lead record.

createdOn.description: Date and time this lead record was created.

leadDate.description: Date the lead was received/captured; the start of the sales process for this prospect.

assignedDate.description: Date the lead was assigned to a sales representative.

activities.description: Scheduled activities (appointments, quote visits, follow-up calls) linked to this lead.

productsOfInterest.description: Product types the prospect has expressed interest in, e.g. blinds, shutters, awnings.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the promotion, e.g. active or inactive.

shipmentID.description: Identifier of the shipment this item belongs to.

supplyJobID.description: Identifier of the supply job the item was shipped against; null when unmatched.

supplyJobLineID.description: Identifier of the supply job line the item was shipped against; null when unmatched.

supplyJobNumber.description: Supply job order number as sent by the supplier; retained even when the supply job could not be matched.

lineNumber.description: Supply job line number as sent by the supplier.

productCode.description: Product code as sent by the supplier.

description.description: Item description as sent by the supplier.

uomCode.description: Unit of measure code for InsyteWeb_Domain.API.V2.Requests.V2_ShipmentLineRequestModel.QtyShipped (e.g. EA).

trackingNumber.description: Carton-level tracking number for this item, when the supplier packs per carton; otherwise see the shipment's TrackingNumbers.

matchStatus.description: Matched (supply job and line found), UnknownLine (supply job found, line not) or UnknownOrder (supply job not found).

V2_ShipmentLineRequestModel.description: One shipped item on a supplier shipment, linked back to the supply job line it was shipped against. Read-only.

supplierID.description: Identifier of the supplier that sent the shipment.

source.description: How the shipment was recorded: EDI (856 ship notice) or Manual.

shipDate.description: Date the goods were shipped by the supplier.

estimatedDeliveryDate.description: Supplier's estimated delivery date, or ship date plus the supplier's transit days when none was sent.

carrierCode.description: Carrier code as sent by the supplier (nominally a SCAC).

carrierName.description: Carrier name as sent by the supplier.

trackingNumbers.description: Semicolon separated carrier tracking / consignment numbers for the whole shipment.

packageCount.description: Number of packages in the shipment.

status.description: Active or Cancelled. Cancelled shipments no longer count towards the supply job's shipped quantities.

cancelledDate.description: Date the shipment was cancelled; null while active.

notes.description: Free-text notes recorded against the shipment.

lines.description: The shipped items, each linked back to the supply job line it was shipped against.

V2_ShipmentRequestModel.description: A supplier shipment (consignment) of goods against one or more supply jobs, received via EDI 856 ship notice or entered manually. Read-only.

supplyJobLineID.description: Identifier of the supply job line whose purchase tax this row breaks down.

taxRateID.description: Identifier of the tax rate applied by this breakdown row.

rate.description: Tax rate percentage applied to the line's cost, snapshotted at time of order (up to 4 decimal places).

taxAmount.description: Tax amount charged on the line's purchase cost at this rate.

V2_SupplyJobLinePurchasingTaxRequestMode.description: Per-tax-rate breakdown of the purchase tax on one supply job line.

supplyJobID.description: Identifier of the parent supply job this line belongs to.

supplyJobLineNo.description: Human-readable line number identifying this line within its supply job.

product.description: Product name snapshot taken at time of order; renames do not update it (ProductID is the stable reference).

productCode.description: Product code snapshot taken at time of order; later code changes do not update it.

productID.description: Stable identifier of the product ordered on this line.

multiProduct.description: Multi-product bundle name snapshot at time of order, when this line is part of a bundle; renames do not update it.

multiProductID.description: Stable identifier of the multi-product bundle (combined product) this line belongs to, if any.

multiGroupID.description: Groups the lines that make up one instance of a multi-product bundle on the supply job.

width.description: Width of the item, stored in the line's ProductBaseUnit; display with ProductBaseUnitFormat.

drop.description: Drop (height) of the item, stored in the line's ProductBaseUnit; display with ProductBaseUnitFormat.

productBaseUnit.description: Measurement unit Width and Drop are stored in (MeasuredValueUnit: 10 mm, 100 cm, 254 inches, 10000 m, 3048 ft, 9144 yd).

productBaseUnitFormat.description: How Width and Drop are displayed (MeasuredValueDisplayFormat flags: 0 number only, 2 with unit abbreviation, 4 inches with fractions, 8 feet+inches with fractions).

qty.description: Quantity of the item ordered on this line.

qtyShipped.description: Quantity the supplier has shipped against this line across active shipments (e.g. EDI 856). May exceed Qty.

location.description: Room in the customer's house the item is for (e.g. "Bedroom 2"); NOT a geographic location.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the supply line (e.g. open, sent, manufacturing, delivered, cancelled).

validationErrors.description: Outstanding product configuration validation errors for the line, if any.

costPrice.description: Actual agreed cost payable to the supplier for this line, excluding tax.

costPriceTax.description: Tax portion of the cost payable to the supplier for this line.

costPriceIncTax.description: Actual agreed cost payable to the supplier for this line, including tax.

baseCostPrice.description: Base product portion of the supplier cost (before options, install and delivery), excluding tax.

installCostPrice.description: Installation portion of the supplier cost, excluding tax.

optionsCostPrice.description: Selected-options portion of the supplier cost, excluding tax.

deliveryCostPrice.description: Delivery portion of the supplier cost, excluding tax.

discountedCostPrice.description: Discount adjustment applied to the supplier cost (ex tax); the gap between list and agreed cost.

displayOption1.description: Business-configurable display column 1 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption2.description: Business-configurable display column 2 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption3.description: Business-configurable display column 3 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption4.description: Business-configurable display column 4 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption5.description: Business-configurable display column 5 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption6.description: Business-configurable display column 6 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption8.description: Business-configurable display column 8 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption9.description: Business-configurable display column 9 showing a selected product option value for the line.

displayOption10.description: Business-configurable display column 10 showing a selected product option value for the line.

manufacturingDate.description: Date the item is scheduled to be (or was) manufactured.

supplierAckDate.description: Date the supplier acknowledged the line (e.g. EDI 855 BAK09).

supplierManufacturingDate.description: Manufacturing date acknowledged by the supplier (e.g. EDI 855), distinct from the internal planning date. Null until the supplier sends one.

supplierETADate.description: Estimated arrival/landing date acknowledged by the supplier (e.g. EDI 855).

manufacturingDepartmentID.description: Identifier of the manufacturing department responsible for producing this item.

jobLineID.description: Identifier of the originating customer job line this supply line fulfils.

purchasingTaxes.description: Per-tax-rate breakdown rows of this line's purchase tax.

shipmentLines.description: Items shipped by the supplier against this line, across all shipments (including cancelled ones; check the shipment's Status). QtyShipped sums the active ones.

V2_SupplyJobLineRequestModel.description: One item line on a supply job (purchase order), linking back to the customer job line it was ordered to fulfil.

orderNumber.description: System-generated order number identifying this supply job (purchase order).

orderDate.description: Date the supply job (purchase order) was raised with the supplier.

jobType.description: Type of the originating customer job the goods are for (e.g. sales or service).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the supply job (e.g. open, sent, delivered, closed, cancelled).

etaDate.description: Estimated date the ordered goods will arrive from the supplier.

supplier.description: Supplier name snapshot taken at time of order; renames do not update it.

supplierOrderNumber.description: Supplier's own order/sales-order number as reported on their acknowledgement (e.g. EDI 855).

firstAckDate.description: Earliest supplier acknowledgement date across the active lines (e.g. EDI 855 BAK09).

firstMFDate.description: Earliest supplier manufacturing date across the active lines; null until the supplier sends one.

lastShipDate.description: Latest ship date across the supplier's active shipments for this supply job (e.g. EDI 856).

trackingNumbers.description: Semicolon separated carrier tracking / consignment numbers across the supplier's active shipments.

shipmentStatus.description: Null (nothing shipped), shipment_status_partial or shipment_status_shipped. Independent of Status.

representativeID.description: Identifier of the staff user responsible for this supply job.

billingAddressID.description: Identifier of the billing address for this supply job.

deliveryAddressID.description: Identifier of the delivery address for the ordered goods.

jobID.description: Identifier of the customer job this supply job procures goods for.

supplyJobLines.description: The item lines ordered on this supply job.

shipmentLines.description: Items shipped by the supplier against this supply job, across all its shipments (including cancelled ones; check the shipment's Status).

rate.description: Tax rate percentage (e.g. 10 for GST 10%); supports up to 4 decimal places.

certifications.description: Licences/accreditations held by this staff member (e.g. a trade licence), with validity periods.
